name: Corn & Soybeans: Seasonal Carry Quintile Patterns
description: Seasonal frequency analysis of futures carry quintiles for corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS). Uses percentrank(2520) on cont.carry for rolling ~10-year quintile assignment (Q1=deepest contango, Q5=deepest backwardation). Chart 1: Heatmap showing observation count by month × quintile — reveals when each carry regime clusters. Chart 2: Bar chart showing % of observations in Q4+Q5 (backwardation) by month — directly answers whether backwardation clusters around planting/harvest.
source:
# Corn & Soybeans: Seasonal Carry Quintile Patterns
# Does backwardation cluster around planting and harvest months?
# cont.carry used directly (already normalized spread/back-contract price)
# percentrank(2520) → rolling ~10yr percentile (0-100 scale)
# Q1 = deepest contango (rank 0-20), Q5 = deepest backwardation (rank 80-100)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry

# --- Rolling Percentile Rank (0-100 scale) ---
carry_rank = percentrank(period=2520)(carry)

# --- Quintile Buckets ---
is_q1 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank <= 20
is_q2 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank > 20 and carry_rank <= 40
is_q3 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank > 40 and carry_rank <= 60
is_q4 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank > 60 and carry_rank <= 80
is_q5 = is_valid(carry_rank) and carry_rank > 80

# --- Month Number (1-12) ---
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(index())

# --- Quintile Number for Heatmap ---
# Assign each bar its quintile number (1-5), NaN if carry_rank not valid
quintile_num = conditional_select(
    is_q1, 1.0,
    is_q2, 2.0,
    is_q3, 3.0,
    is_q4, 4.0,
    is_q5, 5.0,
    0.0
)

# Filter to only valid observations (carry_rank exists)
has_rank = is_valid(carry_rank)
heatmap_val = where(has_rank, 1.0)
heatmap_month = where(has_rank, month_num)
heatmap_quintile = where(has_rank, quintile_num)

# --- For Bar Chart: % of observations in Q4+Q5 (backwardation) by month ---
# 1.0 if in Q4 or Q5, 0.0 if in Q1-Q3, NaN if no rank
backwardation_flag = where(has_rank, 1.0 if (is_q4 or is_q5) else 0.0)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT: 1 category, 1 heatmap + 1 bar chart
# ============================================================

# 1. HEATMAP — Monthly frequency of each carry quintile (observation counts)
# Rows = months (Jan-Dec), Cols = quintiles (Q1-Q5)
# Color intensity shows where each quintile clusters seasonally
heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    title='Carry Quintile Frequency by Month (Observation Count)',
    category='Seasonal Carry Patterns',
    x_axis_label='Carry Quintile',
    y_axis_label='Month',
    y_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    min_color=Color.Gray,
    max_color=Color.Blue,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.0f}',
    order=1
)(x=heatmap_quintile, y=heatmap_month, value=heatmap_val)

# 2. PUNCHLINE — % of backwardation (Q4+Q5) observations by month
# Directly answers: does backwardation cluster around planting/harvest?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Share of Backwardation (Q4+Q5) by Month',
    category='Seasonal Carry Patterns',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    color_by_value=False,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.40, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='40% (Uniform)')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=backwardation_flag, label=month_num)
